formulae.cue_count: count of true report-text tests in each named cue family
formulae.event_window_days: inclusive day count from locked start and end dates
formulae.final_label: all four threshold tests must pass

criteria.description: Includes exactly the requested eight fields with compact scalar values and the required final_label.
criteria.name: Returned JSON shape
criteria.partial_credit: Minor key-order or numeric presentation differences are acceptable; missing required fields or using non-JSON prose loses most credit.

criteria.description: Uses the locked 2023-07-01/2023-08-31 window, computes 62 inclusive days, and extracts the 2023-08-22/2023-08-23 narrative date span.
criteria.name: Window reconstruction
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for one correct window and up to 1 point for using exclusive rather than inclusive day counting.

criteria.description: Reports active_fire_cues=4, smoke_transport_cues=5, and settlement_impact_cues=4 from the report narrative.
criteria.name: Cue counts
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 1.5 points per correct cue family, with small credit for identifying the right family but missing one cue.

criteria.description: Reports dnbr_max=0.86 after rounding the satellite dNBR peak value 0.8597047915007765 to three decimals.
criteria.name: dNBR extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the right unrounded value with different presentation, or 1 point for using the dNBR mean instead of the peak.

criteria.description: Applies active_fire_cues >= 3, smoke_transport_cues >= 4, settlement_impact_cues >= 2, and dnbr_max >= 0.660.
criteria.name: Threshold arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award roughly 0.75 points per correctly evaluated threshold.

criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation concise and limited to the computed smoke-plus-burn ledger.
criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the label is right but the explanation converts qualitative report words into exact loss or area totals.
